pages.title: The Field Guide
pages.text: AuramCore adds $(l:auram:rocks/mining)ore rocks$(/l), a $(l:auram:rocks/catalyst)Rock Catalyst$(/l), $(l:auram:chaos/getting_started)recipe chaos$(/l), and $(l:auram:chaos/quests)quest generation$(/l). It also supplies automatic compatibility patches for the Auram pack.$(br2)Right-click this book to open it. Use the category list, search, and page arrows to explore.
Combine a book, cobblestone and purple dye in any arrangement. The guide also appears in the $(thing)Auram$() creative tab when Patchouli is installed.

pages.title: Player or Operator?
pages.text: Players can use rocks, the catalyst, and Ore Chisel without running admin commands.$(br2)Chaos and quest generation require permission level 2: an operator, or a singleplayer world with commands enabled. Their commands change recipes or quest files for everyone using that world or installation.
